description: Source code for the 'Observation' dialog class in the BORIS software, handling media and data file management, user interactions, and observation parameter validation.

classes.name: AssignConverter
classes.description: Dialog for assigning converters to data columns.

classes.name: Observation
classes.description: Main dialog class for managing observations, including media and data files, user parameters, and validation.

methods.name: check_media_creation_date
methods.description: Checks if all media files contain creation date metadata, searches in metadata and filename.

methods.name: cb_time_offset_changed
methods.description: Enables or disables the time offset widget based on checkbox state.

methods.name: use_media_file_name_as_obsid
methods.description: Sets observation ID from the first media file name loaded in player #1.

methods.name: use_img_dir_as_obsid
methods.description: Sets observation ID from the first images directory.

methods.name: obs_type_changed
methods.description: Switches UI based on selected observation type (media, live, images).

methods.name: add_images_directory
methods.description: Adds a directory of images, handling relative/absolute paths and validation.

methods.name: remove_images_directory
methods.description: Removes selected images directory from list.

methods.name: add_button_menu
methods.description: Recursively adds menu items from a data structure.

methods.name: limit_time_interval
methods.description: Prompts user to set a start and stop time interval for observation.

methods.name: tw_data_files_cellDoubleClicked
methods.description: Handles double-click on data file columns to assign converters.

methods.name: plot_data_file
methods.description: Displays a plot of selected data file with parameters.

methods.name: not_editable_column_color
methods.description: Returns a color for non-editable columns.

methods.name: add_data_file
methods.description: Adds a data file for synchronized plotting, with validation and preview.

methods.name: view_data_file_head_tail
methods.description: Displays first and last rows of a data file.

methods.name: extract_wav
methods.description: Extracts WAV audio from media files loaded in player #1.

methods.name: check_creation_date
methods.description: Verifies media files' existence and creation date metadata.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Handles dialog close event, closing plots if open.

methods.name: pbCancel_clicked
methods.description: Cancels observation creation.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates all observation parameters before starting.

methods.name: pbLaunch_clicked
methods.description: Starts the observation after validation.

methods.name: pbSave_clicked
methods.description: Saves the observation configuration.

methods.name: check_media
methods.description: Checks media file validity and adds to list if valid.

methods.name: update_media_options
methods.description: Updates UI options based on current media list.

methods.name: add_media
methods.description: Adds media files or directories, with validation.

methods.name: add_media_to_listview
methods.description: Adds a media file entry to the list view.

methods.name: remove_data_file
methods.description: Removes selected data files from list.

methods.name: remove_media
methods.description: Removes selected media files from list.
